name: Kingly Shakedown
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
So there we were, about to start plottin' out phase III when a couple o' Magni's blockheads come bargin' in here talkin' bout some kind o' heist and arresting some o' the Hidden Circle.

Well nobody puts the iron on old Blackbeard! The argumentations got heavy and thick and somehow yer name weres blurted out!

Me advice? Take the first Gryphon out o' Ironforge and get to Stormwind. Get yerself to Old Town and once there, talk to an old friend o' mine named Renzik "The Shiv."
narrative.objectives: Travel to Stormwind and seek out Renzik "The Shiv."
narrative.offerRewardText: It's always good to have one of Hulfdan's rogues among our ranks!
